Subject: Architecture run-through: recovery options after missed session

Hi Tom —

Thanks for taking time to put this slot on the calendar today. Attached is a short agenda (tds-agenda.pdf) and the conference dial-in. The session will be a 45-minute architecture deep-dive focused on:
- latency/throughput targets for your ingestion pipeline
- model routing and fallback policies
- data residency and audit-log considerations

Goal: leave with a mutual action plan and a small set of next steps for a pilot. Sergio will lead the deep-dive and Monica will cover integration touchpoints.

Conference: https://meet.redwood.com/meet/tds-nimbus-20270503
Agenda attached.

If anything changes on your side, please let us know and we can pivot — otherwise we’ll plan to proceed.

Best,
Olga

Hi Tom — no worries, thanks for the heads up.

A couple of recovery options that worked well for other prospects when the scheduled session fell through:
1) Quick resurfacing call (30 min) to hit the three core pillars (ingest, routing, audit logs) and create the MAP. We can ship a short recording of the demo afterwards.
2) If stakeholders can't align on time, we can record a 20-minute focused walkthrough of the parts most relevant to you (we'll redact any customer-specific data) and then do a 30-minute sync with your Infra lead + procurement.
3) Blend: record the walkthrough and use a 30-minute working session with your team to drive the pilot definition.

If tomorrow 10:00 PT works, Sergio can run option 1. I've attached a high-level diagram (infra-diagrams.png) that we'll reference — and Sergio will own the deep-dive topics. If you prefer, I can also propose a small mutual action plan template pre-filled for NIM-4782 to accelerate procurement.

Would you like me to send a quick calendar update for Tue 4 May 10:00 PT (30 minutes) or should we wait for Michael and procurement?

Thanks —
Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com
